These rules are presented in an arbitrary order with equal priority. [break]Game administrators may act on judgements not stated by the rules.
### 0. You must be 18 years or older to participate in Pinwheel Anyone found to be below the age of admission will be summarily banned. [break]This server deals in roleplay experiences unsuitable for minors.
### 1. Make an effort to roleplay This server exists to provide a roleplay experience alongside its gameplay. [break]While in control of a character, stay in character, without exception. [break]OOC, LOOC, and Dead chat are explicitly out-of-character.
### 2. Follow roleplay prompts Act in accordance with your job role, antagonist objectives, silicon laws, et cetera. [break]Do not sign up for a role you have no intention of playing.
### 3. Do not abuse the game Do not abuse bugs, modified clients, or external tools to get an advantage.
### 4. Play in good faith Follow the social contract. Don't play just to be a nuisance to others. [break]Bigotry will not be harbored.
